funFact: Turtles are closer to birds and crocodilians than to lizards! The reptile family tree has two main branches: one leading to lizards and snakes, the other to turtles, crocodilians, and birds. Turtles sit just outside Archosauria — the clade of crocodilians, dinosaurs, and birds — making crocodilians the closest living relatives of birds, not turtles. Despite looking like the most "primitive" reptile, a turtle is on the bird-and-croc side of the tree, not the lizard side.
